description: A PHP static analysis tool for finding errors and security vulnerabilities in PHP applications

latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1a665f0114bd40cf12ad57a1a82066549d92f1b6 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* Report what Symfony HttpClient responses hold as input, and the URLs it requests as SSRF sinks by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14950
* feat(strings): strtolower() and strtoupper() of literal strings are literal strings by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14628
### Fixes
* Keep the builtin flags of a namespace known when a library defines constants by a variable name by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14949
* fix(assertions): apply @psalm-assert-if-* of a remembered call compared with a bool by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14605
* fix(arrays): isset() on a sealed array compares a template offset with the keys through its bound by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14603
* fix(assertions): a compound assignment in a condition narrows the variable it assigns by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14532
* fix(reconciliation): a list asserted on a non-empty array is a non-empty list, not impossible by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14609
* fix(types): a callable-object is not an object shape or a callable-object of another signature by @MikeFTV in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14929
* [7.x] Fix: Check a constructed template against its siblings' constraints by @jarstelfox in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/12443
### Internal changes
* Don't put the methods of anonymous classes in the generated callmaps by @danog in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14952
* test: regression tests for four issues fixed on master by @jirkace in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/14523
* [7.x] Cut linking generator sends in taint resolution ~40% (17 s to 10 s) by skipping nodes no generator flows into by @jarstelfox in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13504
* [7.x] Report taint flows after the resolution's fixed point: resolution 28.9s → 15.5s by @jarstelfox in https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/pull/13539


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/compare/7.20.0...7.21.0

detail.readme:
Psalm

[![Packagist](https://img.shields.io/packagist/v/vimeo/psalm.svg)](https://packagist.org/packages/vimeo/psalm) [![Packagist](https://img.shields.io/packagist/dt/vimeo/psalm.svg)](https://packagist.org/packages/vimeo/psalm) [![Psalm coverage](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm/coverage.svg?)](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm) [![Psalm level](https://shepherd.dev/github/vimeo/psalm/level.svg?)](https://psalm.dev/) Psalm is a static analysis tool for finding errors in PHP applications. [Join the official Psalm news channel](https://t.me/psalmphp) and the Psalm community on [Telegram](https://t.me/psalmphp_community) and [Discord](https://discord.gg/RwH8rEpxt9)! ## Installation To get started, check out the [installation guide](docs/running_psalm/installation.md). ## Live Demo You can play around with Psalm [on its website](https://psalm.dev/). ## Documentation Documentation is available on [Psalm’s website](https://psalm.dev/docs), generated from the [docs](https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/blob/master/docs) folder. ## Support Psalm development You can support Psalm development by requesting a support contract from [Daniil Gentili](https://daniil.it), the only active maintainer of Psalm. Support contracts can cover full integration of Psalm into existing codebases, support for Psalm issues and development of additional Psalm features. See [here »](https://daniil.it) for info, pricing and contact information. ## Interested in contributing? Have a look at [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Who made this Built by Matt Brown ([@muglug](https://github.com/muglug)). Maintained by Daniil Gentili ([@danog](https://github.com/danog)), Alies Lapatsin ([@alies-dev](https://github.com/alies-dev)) and Orklah ([@orklah](https://github.com/orklah)). Former maintainer: Bruce Weirdan ([@weirdan](https://github.com/weirdan)). The engineering team at [Vimeo](https://github.com/vimeo) have provided a lot encouragement, especially [@nbeliard](https://github.com/nbeliard), [@erunion](https://github.com/erunion) and [@nickyr](https://github.com/nickyr).
